extraction.summary: Replaces last-write-wins sync in a notes app with Yjs documents persisted to IndexedDB and synced over WebSocket, and notes that CRDT history grows.

claims.statement: Syncing whole documents with last-write-wins silently drops one device's changes when two devices edit the same note offline.
Persist each Yjs document to IndexedDB on every change and sync updates over WebSocket when online, so the app keeps working while the server is unreachable.
CRDT documents keep enough history to merge, so heavily edited documents grow over time.

solution.statement: With a CRDT, users can modify the data on any replica independently, and the CRDT merges the changes automatically into a consistent state.

concern.statement: Syncing whole documents with last-write-wins silently drops one device's changes when two devices edit the same note offline.

solution.statement: Persist each Yjs document to IndexedDB on every change and sync updates over WebSocket when online, so the app keeps working while the server is unreachable.

concern.statement: A cloud app cannot be used at all while its service is unavailable, for example when the device is offline.
